# Leading the Future of Agriculture

Helena Agri-Enterprises is one of the nation’s foremost agronomic providers of crop inputs,
application technology, manufacturing and data solutions. For nearly 70 years, our people have been
driven to providing sustainable solutions that help feed, clothe and fuel the world.

[Our Company][61]

## Our Expertise

Helena is a global leader in developing and manufacturing products for the agriculture, turf and
ornamental industry. These inputs are strengthened by our decades-long experience in precision
technology and data management. Explore our products and services to find the right fit for your
unique operation.

[Our Expertise][62]

[Helena Pillars]

## Our Advantage

Grounded by tradition yet empowered by innovation, Helena combines the power of relationships with
forward-thinking ideas. We work alongside our customers to meet evolving agronomic needs by
discovering and implementing new technology. Learn how we’re impacting agriculture and specialty
markets now and in the future.

[Our Advantage][63]

## Sustainability

At Helena Agri-Enterprises, sustainability drives everything we do. Guided by three pillars —
People, Products, and Knowledge — we focus on reducing greenhouse gas emissions, supporting the
United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals, and fostering a culture of respect and opportunity.
Discover exactly how Helena is shaping a more sustainable future for agriculture and the communities
we serve.

[Sustainability][64]

## Stay in touch

Subscribe to Helena communications and receive the latest news and information impacting your
business.

[Subscribe][65]

# Leading the Future of Agriculture

Helena Agri-Enterprises is one of the nation’s foremost agronomic providers of crop inputs,
application technology, manufacturing and data solutions. For nearly 70 years, our people have been
driven to providing sustainable solutions that help feed, clothe and fuel the world.

[Our Company][61]

## Our Expertise

Helena is a global leader in developing and manufacturing products for the agriculture, turf and
ornamental industry. These inputs are strengthened by our decades-long experience in precision
technology and data management. Explore our products and services to find the right fit for your
unique operation.

[Our Expertise][62]

[Helena Pillars]

## Our Advantage

Grounded by tradition yet empowered by innovation, Helena combines the power of relationships with
forward-thinking ideas. We work alongside our customers to meet evolving agronomic needs by
discovering and implementing new technology. Learn how we’re impacting agriculture and specialty
markets now and in the future.

[Our Advantage][63]

## Sustainability

At Helena Agri-Enterprises, sustainability drives everything we do. Guided by three pillars —
People, Products, and Knowledge — we focus on reducing greenhouse gas emissions, supporting the
United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals, and fostering a culture of respect and opportunity.
Discover exactly how Helena is shaping a more sustainable future for agriculture and the communities
we serve.

[Sustainability][64]

## Stay in touch

Subscribe to Helena communications and receive the latest news and information impacting your
business.

[Subscribe][65]

protect and enhance our planet. Headquartered in Switzerland, we are a global agritech leader with

About

Syngenta

**We are a leading, science-based agriculture company, empowering farmers to meet the demands of
modern agriculture. Using cutting-edge innovation, we help farmers to grow resilient, healthy crops
that can feed a growing global population, while promoting sustainable farming practices that
protect and enhance our planet. Headquartered in Switzerland, we are a global agritech leader with
more than 30,000 employees across over 90 countries.**

[Learn more about Syngenta][71]

## ANSWER PLOT^{®} PROGRAM

The Answer Plot^{®} Program is a premier research and demonstration resource that has produced more
than 5 million data points and one of the industry’s most extensive data sets. Product performance
is tested and proven in replicated field trials at nearly 200 Answer Plot® locations. Along with our
trusted retail partners, we use applied science to analyze and compare statistical seed and crop
protection data from CROPLAN^{®} and WinField^{®} United products, as well as competitor and partner
products. This localized information combined with the knowledge of your local retailer ensures your
seed and management decisions are fine-tuned down to the acre.

## We have been providing affordable, quality pesticide services for 34 years

Working the pesticide industry for 34 years,we know the product preferences of each market well. Our
goal is to deliver high quality and efficient pesticide products at affordable prices to customers
all over the world.

### Diversified products

Provide numerous products with complete functions,support processing into different
specification,owning a complete industrial chain.

### Customized Packaging

Design different products with exquisite appearance according to the customer's region,and accept
customized packaging.

[service]

Our strengths！ Glyphosate has an annual production capacity of over 100,000 tons,Acetochlor
production exceeds 5000 tons. Highly effective herbicides protect the healthy growth of plants.

[service]

Classic insecticide preparations and commonly used multi-action combinations are protective barriers
to protect plants from insect infestations.

[service]

that invade plants,fungicides are the safety guards of plants,build a strong protective safety line
for them.

advantage.

into different formulations.

Comprehending evolving demands for high quality crop protection products, we, Eagle Plant Protect
Private Limited, forayed into the manufacturing domain in 2009. Within this short span of time, we
have established ourselves as a well known manufacturer, supplier, trader, wholesaler and buyer
company, with proven specialization in manufacturing a diversified range of Plant Protectors,
Pesticides, Insecticides, Plant Growth Regulator and Fungicide. Manufactured as per latest
production technology, these are safe, reliable and environment friendly.

controlling pesticides like larva, heliothis and ball worm, these are successfully addressing needs
of various agricultural sectors. Moreover, to ensure that our formulated range meets global quality
standards, our designers and packaging experts carefully design the products as per the
specifications and requirements of the customers.

## Our Industry Solutions

[Stationary industries, alternative]

### Industrial Applications

Whether it’s hydrogen technologies, geothermal energy or machine tools – HYDAC is active worldwide
in all kinds of industrial applications. Here you will find an overview of our products and services

Driving Growth, Protecting the Planet

**Farming for a Greener Future**
At JT Crop, sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to providing
eco-friendly solutions that minimize environmental impact while enhancing agricultural productivity.
Our products are designed to ensure responsible farming practices, safeguarding the planet for
future generations. Together, we’re cultivating a sustainable tomorrow.

**Pioneering the Future of Agriculture**
Innovation drives our mission to revolutionize farming. At JT Crop, we embrace cutting-edge
technologies and groundbreaking ideas to develop solutions that address modern agricultural
challenges. From advanced crop protection to precision farming tools, our innovations empower
farmers to maximize efficiency and yields like never before.

**Where Science Meets Agriculture**
Our state-of-the-art R&D facility is the backbone of our success. Equipped with the latest
technology and led by a team of experts, it enables us to create next-generation agro-chemical
solutions. By continuously researching and testing, we ensure our products meet the highest
standards of quality, safety, and efficacy.

### JT Crop Global Footprint

JT Crop has established a strong global presence with head offices and manufacturing facilities
across multiple continents. Our head offices are located in India, Poland, and United Kingdom, while
our state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities are situated in India and the United Kingdom. This
extensive network enables us to deliver innovative agricultural solutions worldwide.

### Sustainability and Innovation at the Core

Driving Growth, Protecting the Planet

[Sustainability][45]
[Innovation][46]
[R&D][47]

**Farming for a Greener Future**
At JT Crop, sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to providing
eco-friendly solutions that minimize environmental impact while enhancing agricultural productivity.
Our products are designed to ensure responsible farming practices, safeguarding the planet for
future generations. Together, we’re cultivating a sustainable tomorrow.

**Pioneering the Future of Agriculture**
Innovation drives our mission to revolutionize farming. At JT Crop, we embrace cutting-edge
technologies and groundbreaking ideas to develop solutions that address modern agricultural
challenges. From advanced crop protection to precision farming tools, our innovations empower
farmers to maximize efficiency and yields like never before.

**Where Science Meets Agriculture**
Our state-of-the-art R&D facility is the backbone of our success. Equipped with the latest
technology and led by a team of experts, it enables us to create next-generation agro-chemical
solutions. By continuously researching and testing, we ensure our products meet the highest
standards of quality, safety, and efficacy.

## לידור אלמנטס

היא אחת החברות המובילות בישראל ליישום חומרים, מוצרים וטכנולוגיות בתחומי התעשיה והגנת הצומח. מזה 50
שנה, אנו מלווים חברות רבות בישראל, מהגדולות במשק ועד מיזמים ראשוניים, מייעצים במסירות ומספקים
פתרונות לצרכיהן ואתגריהן. אנו מייבאים, מוכרים ומפיצים חומרים ומוצרים באיכות הגבוהה ביותר, לרבות
פתרונות טכנולוגיים מתקדמים המשפרים יעילות ומסייעים ביצירת עתיד בר-קיימא. לספקינו הבינלאומיים, אנו
מציעים שירותים עסקיים נרחבים, פתרונות לוגיסטיים מקצה לקצה ותמיכה רגולטורית מלאה.

## לידור אלמנטס

היא אחת החברות המובילות בישראל ליישום חומרים, מוצרים וטכנולוגיות בתחומי התעשיה והגנת הצומח. מזה 50
שנה, אנו מלווים חברות רבות בישראל, מהגדולות במשק ועד מיזמים ראשוניים, מייעצים במסירות ומספקים
פתרונות לצרכיהן ואתגריהן. אנו מייבאים, מוכרים ומפיצים חומרים ומוצרים באיכות הגבוהה ביותר, לרבות
פתרונות טכנולוגיים מתקדמים המשפרים יעילות ומסייעים ביצירת עתיד בר-קיימא. לספקינו הבינלאומיים, אנו
מציעים שירותים עסקיים נרחבים, פתרונות לוגיסטיים מקצה לקצה ותמיכה רגולטורית מלאה.

WELCOME TO

MAHAMAYA LIFESCIENCES

Mahamaya was established in 2002. With the vast experience of the promoter in the agrochemical
sector Mahamaya’s focus and investment were on registration of vital molecules that were important
for Indian Agriculture. At Mahamaya, we strive to become a better model in the crop protection
industry. It’s our responsibility to make the agricultural world more productive making pesticide
usage more conducive and farmer friendly. We have grown with our farmers; it becomes our moral duty
to thank them and promote quality agro products among them. As a responsible crop protection
producer our pledge is to help the world reach the UN sustainable goals about zero hunger and double
agricultural productivity and provide quality of life to the farmers.

###### Faq Us

### We Are Any Question Faq Pesticides

Choosing the right pesticide based on your crop and pest problem is essential for effective
protection.

#### Are pesticides safe for humans and the environment?

When used correctly and in recommended doses, pesticides can be safe. However, improper use can harm
humans, animals, and ecosystems. Organic and biopesticides are safer alternatives.

#### How do I choose the right pesticide for my crops?

Choose pesticides based on the specific pest problem, crop type, and environmental impact. Always
follow expert recommendations and label instructions.

#### Can I mix different pesticides?

Some pesticides can be mixed, but others may react negatively. Always check compatibility charts and
follow manufacturer guidelines before mixing.

#### How often should I apply pesticides?

It depends on the crop, pest severity, and weather conditions. Follow the application schedule
mentioned on the pesticide label.

###### Faq Us

### We Are Any Question Faq Pesticides

Choosing the right pesticide based on your crop and pest problem is essential for effective
protection.

#### Are pesticides safe for humans and the environment?

When used correctly and in recommended doses, pesticides can be safe. However, improper use can harm
humans, animals, and ecosystems. Organic and biopesticides are safer alternatives.

#### How do I choose the right pesticide for my crops?

Choose pesticides based on the specific pest problem, crop type, and environmental impact. Always
follow expert recommendations and label instructions.

#### Can I mix different pesticides?

Some pesticides can be mixed, but others may react negatively. Always check compatibility charts and
follow manufacturer guidelines before mixing.

#### How often should I apply pesticides?

It depends on the crop, pest severity, and weather conditions. Follow the application schedule
mentioned on the pesticide label.

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

#### Water Conservation

With cutting-edge systems, we recycle over 185 million litres of water every year. In FY24 alone,
113 million litres were recycled, an 87% increase from FY23. Supporting our commitment to
responsible water use and long-term sustainability.

#### Waste Management and Circularity

With strategic partnerships, 100% recycled packaging and Eco Scale tracking, we reduce hazardous
waste and optimise waste generation per metric tonne, advancing circularity across operations.

contribute 6.60% of total energy use. The shift to cleaner fuels has more than doubled this share,
significantly reducing greenhouse gas emissions.

Rammam Agro Industries Private Limited is a trusted manufacturer, supplier, and exporter of
premium-quality agrochemicals and crop protection solutions. Established in 2018, the company has
earned a strong reputation for delivering innovative, reliable, and high-performance agricultural
products that help farmers achieve healthier crops and higher yields. Our comprehensive product
portfolio includes Cypermethrin 10 EC, Bispyribac Sodium 10% SC, Profenofos 40% + Cypermethrin 4% EC
Insecticide, Pendimethalin, Profenophos 50% EC, Liquid Seaweed Fertilizer, and Emamectin Benzoate 5%
SG.

With modern manufacturing facilities, advanced formulation technology, and stringent quality control
systems, we ensure that every product complies with national and international quality standards.
Our commitment to innovation, consistency, and customer satisfaction has enabled us to build a
strong distribution network across India while expanding our presence in international markets. We
continuously strive to provide effective crop protection and plant nutrition solutions that support
sustainable agriculture and maximize farm productivity.

**Our Infrastructure**

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing unit is equipped with advanced processing machinery, formulation
equipment, quality testing laboratories, and efficient packaging facilities. Every production stage
is carefully monitored by experienced professionals to ensure consistent quality, purity, and
effectiveness of our agrochemical formulations.

Our infrastructure enables us to manufacture bulk quantities while maintaining timely deliveries and
strict adherence to environmental and safety regulations.

**Our Team**

Our success is driven by a dedicated team of skilled professionals who possess extensive knowledge
of agrochemical manufacturing and quality management. Every team member is committed to maintaining
the highest standards of product quality and customer satisfaction.

Our workforce includes:

* Agricultural Scientists
* Chemical Engineers
* Production Experts
* Research & Development Professionals
* Quality Control Analysts
* Packaging Specialists
* Warehousing & Logistics Personnel
* Sales & Technical Support Executives

Regular training programs help our team stay updated with the latest agricultural technologies,
manufacturing practices, and industry standards.

**Quality Assurance**

Quality remains the cornerstone of our operations. We procure superior-grade raw materials from
trusted vendors and subject every batch to rigorous quality testing before dispatch. Our products
are carefully formulated to ensure maximum effectiveness, stability, and safety while meeting
applicable regulatory standards.

Stringent quality checks are conducted at every stage of manufacturing to ensure farmers receive
reliable and consistent agrochemical solutions.

* Established in 2018 with years of industry experience
* Premium-quality agrochemical formulations
* Modern manufacturing and testing facilities
* Strict quality assurance practices
* Timely delivery and efficient supply chain
* Competitive pricing
* Customer-focused approach
* Wide distribution network across domestic and export markets
* Commitment to sustainable and productive agriculture

## Find. Vet. Source.

SC CHEM is a family-owned, sourcing-first distribution partner that helps companies secure complex
and hard-to-find chemicals through a single, end-to-end process. By combining global supplier
networks with hands-on expertise, we simplify sourcing while delivering the personal service you

## A Family-Owned Partner with Global Reach

As a family-owned company based in the United States, SC CHEM brings decades of global sourcing
experience to every engagement. Our clients benefit from deep industry knowledge, trusted supplier
relationships, and a highly personalized approach that allows us to move quickly and solve complex
sourcing challenges. 

[VIEW OUR PRODUCTS][42]
[SC CHEM Team Photo Original 2025.jpg]
[Chemical Treatment Plant stock image.jpg]

## One Stop, One Partner

Our trusted global network of chemical manufacturers and technical partners allows SC CHEM to source
even the most challenging materials. Tell us what you need, and we’ll take care of identifying,
vetting, and coordinating the right solution. If a material can’t be sourced, we work with qualified
partners to have it made and delivered to your specifications.

[VIEW SERVICES ][43]

## Our Story

Founded by industry expert Frank Fisher, SC CHEM is built on decades of global importing, sourcing,
and supplier relationship experience. That foundation drives our commitment to transparency, trust,
and solving complex sourcing challenges for our clients. 

[MORE ABOUT SC CHEM ][44]

developments.

## About Us

##### Hebei Tangyun Biotech Co.,ltd.

Hebei Tangyun Biotech Co., Ltd. is a professional China-based agrochemical foreign trade enterprise
rooted in Shijiazhuang, Hebei Province.
For over 15 years, we have focused on the full agrochemical supply chain, serving global
agricultural importers, regional distributors, and small & medium agribusinesses across more than 30
countries, with our core strengths in customized pesticide packaging and flexible low-MOQ solutions.
* Multilingual label design matching regional market regulatory requirements (Arabic, Spanish,
  English, etc.)
* Custom bottle molds, unique color schemes, hologram anti-counterfeit labels, and flexible
  packaging sizes
* Optimized packaging volume design to cut ocean freight costs by up to 35%

We help overseas clients build their exclusive local agricultural brands with zero threshold, low
MOQ support, and a standout service for small and medium agricultural traders who cannot afford
large bulk orders.
